name: Connections Summer Expeditions
description_short: Free 5- or 7-day overnight expeditions (backpacking/climbing or sea kayaking/camping) on Cathleen Stone Island and in Boston Harbor for rising 7th and 8th graders enrolled in Boston Public Schools. Students cook, set up shelters, and learn wilderness skills, teamwork and environmental stewardship.
swim_waterfront_notes: Kayaking expeditions paddle Boston Harbor in two-person sea kayaks. Instruction covers paddling, capsize and rescue procedures, weather forecasting and navigation. No kayaking or outdoor experience needed.

warnings: The page only lists the 2026 season (July 26 to August 12, 2026), which has already happened as of 2026-10-13. Dates for 2027 are not posted yet.
Only students enrolled in Boston Public Schools can apply.

The program email address is hidden on the scraped page, so no email was recorded.
The ferry description mentions 'Thompson Island', which appears to be the island's former name.
